conditional_findings.first_contract: A support rejection should identify whether ground bearing or a directional threshold is absent while retaining the property and building identities.
conditional_findings.trace: At95e, plan_compound_support validates unique physical building IDs before building its map, clones its recipe palette and collects compound plans as a Result. member resolves the exact program and obtains ground_floor_contact_bounds. That API folds all fixed-solid ground-contact points into an Option, returning None when there are none, and propagates geometry errors separately. In member, Ok(None) invokes the same closure used for a missing directional door: it constructs MissingBinding with Threshold(outward). The single-property bearing path instead uses GroundBearing for the same absence. Invalid contact geometry maps to InvalidBearing. Recipe::for_program selects an exact program or compiles that same program; door_point returns None on zero or multiple outward doors.
conditional_findings.safeguards_and_limits: This is a current reassessment of the existing059 Adler finding, also independently observed in the original Segovb585 Lens12 receipt, not a new historical finding or proof of checkpoint3821. An admitted generated recipe with no ground-contact points, an actual top-level report, error source-chain behavior, and exact aliases were not established. No fixture, generator, test, repair or runtime was run. The source shows the conditional return identity and not a recorded failed settlement.
